lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately 4-5 horizontal rows extending from the posterior margin of the gill slits toward the caudal peduncle, with regular spacing between adjacent centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, forming a geometric lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent linear feature extending horizontally from the mid-point of the dorsal margin to the base of the second dorsal fin, exhibiting a high-contrast transition between upper highlight and lower shadow zones.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs; one primary high-intensity spot located on the upper anterior region of the fin, with secondary smaller clusters near the posterior base.
